description: This file defines an interface for endpoint discovery configuration options within the AWS SDK for PHP. It specifies methods for checking if endpoint discovery is enabled, retrieving cache limits, and exporting configuration as an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface for endpoint discovery configuration options in the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether or not endpoint discovery is enabled.

methods.name: getCacheLimit
methods.description: Returns the cache limit, if available.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
